{"parentUuid":"2613a032-cc02-43dd-b71c-1fdf1a9dfd07","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_8h5zaxu8atqbkwfp95xckxue","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/b/src/http.rs","content":"//! Zero-dependency local HTTP/1.1 validation entrypoint (stdlib only).\n//!\n//! Exposes the real file-backed store under `/kv*`, plus deterministic\n//! crash-injection demos under `/demo*` (these run entirely on the in-memory\n//! [`SimVfs`], so they never touch the real data directory).\n\nuse std::collections::BTreeMap;\nuse std::io::{Read, Write};\nuse std::net::{TcpListener, TcpStream};\nuse std::sync::{Arc, Mutex};\n\nuse crate::demo::{self, CaseResult, Json, NamedScenario};\nuse crate::io::{CrashPolicy, RealVfs};\nuse crate::repo::{Repository, StoreError};\n\npub struct ServerState {\n    pub store: Mutex<Repository<RealVfs>>,\n}\n\npub fn serve(dir: &str, addr: &str) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    let vfs = RealVfs::open(dir).map_err(io_err)?;\n    let (store, report) = Repository::open(vfs).map_err(|e| std::io::Error::other(e.to_string()))?;\n    let state = Arc::new(ServerState {\n        store: Mutex::new(store),\n    });\n\n    eprintln!(\"data directory: {dir}\");\n    eprintln!(\"recovery: selected {:?} gen {:?}, data {} bytes ({} orphan byte(s) truncated)\",\n        report.selected_slot,\n        report.selected_generation,\n        report.data_len_after,\n        report.truncated_orphan_bytes);\n    for s in &report.slots {\n        eprintln!(\n            \"  slot {} present={} accepted={}: {}\",\n            s.slot, s.present, s.accepted, s.detail\n        );\n    }\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr)?;\n    eprintln!(\"listening on http://{addr}\");\n    for stream in listener.incoming() {\n        match stream {\n            Ok(stream) => {\n                let state = Arc::clone(&state);\n                // Threads per connection are fine for a local validation tool.\n                std::thread::spawn(move || {\n                    if let Err(e) = handle_connection(stream, &state) {\n                        eprintln!(\"connection error: {e}\");\n                    }\n                });\n            }\n            Err(e) => eprintln!(\"accept error: {e}\"),\n        }\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn io_err(e: crate::io::IoError) -> std::io::Error {\n    std::io::Error::other(e.to_string())\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Connection / routing\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream, state: &Arc<ServerState>) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5)))?;\n    let mut buf = [0u8; 64 * 1024];\n    let mut total = 0usize;\n    let header_end;\n    loop {\n        let n = stream.read(&mut buf[total..])?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        total += n;\n        if let Some(pos) = find_subsequence(&buf[..total], b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\") {\n            header_end = pos;\n            break;\n        }\n        if total == buf.len() {\n            return Ok(()); // headers too large; drop\n        }\n    }\n    let head = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..header_end]).to_string();\n    let mut lines = head.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let request_line = lines.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let mut parts = request_line.split(' ');\n    let method = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let target = parts.next().unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let (path, query) = target.split_once('?').unwrap_or((target, \"\"));\n\n    // Body: Content-Length bytes following the header terminator.\n    let content_length = head\n        .split(\"\\r\\n\")\n        .find_map(|l| {\n            let (k, v) = l.split_once(':')?;\n            if k.eq_ignore_ascii_case(\"content-length\") {\n                v.trim().parse::<usize>().ok()\n            } else {\n                None\n            }\n        })\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n    let mut body = buf[header_end + 4..total].to_vec();\n    while body.len() < content_length {\n        let mut tmp = [0u8; 8192];\n        let n = stream.read(&mut tmp)?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            break;\n        }\n        body.extend_from_slice(&tmp[..n]);\n    }\n    body.truncate(content_length);\n\n    let resp = route(method, path, query, &body, state);\n    write_response(&mut stream, resp)\n}\n\nstruct Response {\n    status: u16,\n    json: Json,\n}\n\nfn route(method: &str, path: &str, query: &str, body: &[u8], state: &Arc<ServerState>) -> Response {\n    match (method, path) {\n        (\"GET\", \"/health\") => ok(Json::Obj(vec![\n            (\"status\".into(), Json::s(\"ok\")),\n            (\"service\".into(), Json::s(\"dual-sb-recovery\")),\n        ])),\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/kv\") => {\n            let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();\n            let entries = store\n                .entries()\n                .into_iter()\n                .map(|(k, v)| {\n                    Json::Obj(vec![(\"key\".into(), Json::s(k)), (\"value\".into(), Json::s(v))])\n                })\n                .collect();\n            ok(Json::Obj(vec![\n                (\"generation\".into(), Json::n(store.generation())),\n                (\"data_len\".into(), Json::n(store.data_len())),\n                (\"entries\".into(), Json::Arr(entries)),\n            ]))\n        }\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/kv/get\") => {\n            let params = parse_query(query);\n            match params.get(\"key\") {\n                Some(key) => {\n                    let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();\n                    match store.get(key.as_bytes()) {\n                        Some(v) => ok(Json::Obj(vec![\n                            (\"key\".into(), Json::s(key.clone())),\n                            (\"value\".into(), Json::s(String::from_utf8_lossy(v).into_owned())),\n                        ])),\n                        None => err404(\"key not found\"),\n                    }\n                }\n                None => err400(\"missing ?key=\"),\n            }\n        }\n\n        (\"POST\", \"/kv/put\") => match parse_put_body(body) {\n            Ok((key, value)) => {\n                let mut store = state.store.lock().unwrap();\n                match store.put(key.into_bytes(), value.into_bytes()) {\n                    Ok(gen) => ok(Json::Obj(vec![\n                        (\"committed_generation\".into(), Json::n(gen)),\n                        (\"data_len\".into(), Json::n(store.data_len())),\n                    ])),\n                    Err(e) => err500(&e),\n                }\n            }\n            Err(msg) => err400(&msg),\n        },\n\n        (\"POST\", \"/kv/delete\") => match parse_delete_body(body, query) {\n            Ok(key) => {\n                let mut store = state.store.lock().unwrap();\n                match store.delete(key.into_bytes()) {\n                    Ok(gen) => ok(Json::Obj(vec![\n                        (\"committed_generation\".into(), Json::n(gen)),\n                    ])),\n                    Err(e) => err500(&e),\n                }\n            }\n            Err(msg) => err400(&msg),\n        },\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/demo/matrix\") => {\n            let cases = demo::run_matrix();\n            ok(matrix_json(&cases, \"crash during commit 3: 8 points x 3 torn variants\"))\n        }\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/demo/matrix2\") => {\n            let cases = demo::run_round2_matrix();\n            ok(matrix_json(&cases, \"crash during commit 2 (first rollback): half-page torn\"))\n        }\n\n        (\"POST\", \"/demo/crash\") => {\n            // body: {\"point\":\"RootWriteEnd\",\"torn\":\"Half\",\"round\":3}\n            let parsed = parse_json_object(body);\n            let point = parsed\n                .get(\"point\")\n                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n                .and_then(demo::parse_point);\n            let torn = parsed\n                .get(\"torn\")\n                .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n                .and_then(demo::parse_torn)\n                .unwrap_or(demo::TornDefault::get());\n            let rounds = parsed\n                .get(\"round\")\n                .and_then(|v| v.as_u64())\n                .unwrap_or(3)\n                .clamp(1, 100);\n            match (point, torn) {\n                (Some(point), torn) => {\n                    let case = demo::run_single(CrashPolicy::new(point, torn), rounds);\n                    ok(case_json(&case))\n                }\n                _ => err400(\"body must be {\\\"point\\\": <CrashPoint>, \\\"torn\\\": None|Half|Short, \\\"round\\\": N}\"),\n            }\n        }\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/demo/scenarios\") => {\n            let named = demo::all_named();\n            let arr = named\n                .iter()\n                .map(|s| {\n                    Json::Obj(vec![\n                        (\"name\".into(), Json::s(s.name.clone())),\n                        (\"description\".into(), Json::s(s.description.clone())),\n                        (\"outcome\".into(), Json::s(s.outcome.clone())),\n                        (\"report\".into(), s.report.clone()),\n                    ])\n                })\n                .collect();\n            ok(Json::Obj(vec![(\"scenarios\".into(), Json::Arr(arr))]))\n        }\n\n        _ => Response {\n            status: 404,\n            json: Json::Obj(vec![(\"error\".into(), Json::s(\"no such route\") )]),\n        },\n    }\n}\n\nfn matrix_json(cases: &[CaseResult], title: &str) -> Json {\n    let total = cases.len() as u64;\n    let passed = cases.iter().filter(|c| c.passed()).count() as u64;\n    let arr = cases.iter().map(case_json_min).collect();\n    Json::Obj(vec![\n        (\"title\".into(), Json::s(title)),\n        (\"cases\".into(), Json::n(total)),\n        (\"passed\".into(), Json::n(passed)),\n        (\"all_passed\".into(), Json::Bool(passed == total)),\n        (\"results\".into(), Json::Arr(arr)),\n    ])\n}\n\nfn case_json_min(c: &CaseResult) -> Json {\n    Json::Obj(vec![\n        (\"point\".into(), Json::s(c.point)),\n        (\"torn\".into(), Json::s(c.torn)),\n        (\"recovered_generation\".into(), optn(c.recovered_generation)),\n        (\"expected_generation\".into(), Json::n(c.expected_generation)),\n        (\"value\".into(), match &c.last_value {\n            Some(v) => Json::s(v),\n            None => Json::Null,\n        }),\n        (\"orphan_bytes_truncated\".into(), Json::n(c.orphan_bytes_truncated)),\n        (\"passed\".into(), Json::Bool(c.passed())),\n    ])\n}\n\nfn case_json(c: &CaseResult) -> Json {\n    let slots = c\n        .slot_reports\n        .iter()\n        .map(|(slot, present, accepted, detail)| {\n            Json::Obj(vec![\n                (\"slot\".into(), Json::n(*slot as u64)),\n                (\"present\".into(), Json::Bool(*present)),\n                (\"accepted\".into(), Json::Bool(*accepted)),\n                (\"detail\".into(), Json::s(detail.clone())),\n            ])\n        })\n        .collect();\n    let mut obj = vec![\n        (\"crashed_round\".into(), Json::n(c.crashed_round)),\n        (\"point\".into(), Json::s(c.point)),\n        (\"torn\".inside(), Json::s(c.torn)),\n        (\"opened\".into(), Json::Bool(c.opened)),\n        (\"recovered_generation\".inside(), optn(c.recovered_generation)),\n        (\"expected_generation\".into(), Json::n(c.expected_generation)),\n        (\"orphan_bytes_truncated\".into(), Json::n(c.orphan_bytes_truncated)),\n        (\"slots\".into(), Json::Arr(slots)),\n        (\"passed\".into(), Json::Bool(c.passed())),\n    ];\n    if let Some(e) = &c.error {\n        obj.push((\"error\".into(), Json::s(e.clone())));\n    }\n    Json::Obj(obj)\n}\n\nfn optn(v: Option<u64>) -> Json {\n    match v {\n        Some(n) => Json::n(n),\n        None => Json::Null,\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Tiny JSON parser (flat objects + strings/numbers/null/bool), enough for\n// the request bodies this service accepts.\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\npub fn parse_json_object(body: &[u8]) -> BTreeMap<String, Json> {\n    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();\n    let s = std::str::from_utf8(body).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    let bytes = s.as_bytes();\n    let mut i = skip_ws(bytes, 0);\n    if i >= bytes.len() || bytes[i] != b'{' {\n        return out;\n    }\n    i += 1;\n    loop {\n        i = skip_ws(bytes, i);\n        if i >= bytes.len() {\n            break;\n        }\n        if bytes[i] == b'}' {\n            break;\n        }\n        if bytes[i] != b'\"' {\n            break;\n        }\n        let (key, ni) = match read_json_string(bytes, i) {\n            Some(x) => x,\n            None => break,\n        };\n        i = skip_ws(bytes, ni);\n        if i >= bytes.len() || bytes[i] != b':' {\n            break;\n        }\n        i += 1;\n        i = skip_ws(bytes, i);\n        let (val, ni) = match read_json_value(bytes, i) {\n            Some(x) => x,\n            None => break,\n        };\n        out.insert(key, val);\n        i = skip_ws(bytes, ni);\n        if i < bytes.len() && bytes[i] == b',' {\n            i += 1;\n            continue;\n        }\n        if i < bytes.len() && bytes[i] == b'}' {\n            break;\n        }\n        break;\n    }\n    out\n}\n\nfn skip_ws(b: &[u8], mut i: usize) -> usize {\n    while i < b.len() && matches!(b[i], b' ' | b'\\t' | b'\\n' | b'\\r') {\n        i += 1;\n    }\n    i\n}\n\nfn read_json_string(b: &[u8], start: usize) -> Option<(String, usize)> {\n    if b[start] != b'\"' {\n        return None;\n    }\n    let mut i = start + 1;\n    let mut out = String::new();\n    while i < b.len() {\n        match b[i] {\n            b'\"' => return Some((out, i + 1)),\n            b'\\\\' if i + 1 < b.len() => {\n                match b[i + 1] {\n                    b'n' => out.push('\\n'),\n                    b't' => out.push('\\t'),\n                    b'r' => out.push('\\r'),\n                    b'\"' => out.push('\"'),\n                    b'\\\\' => out.push('\\\\'),\n                    b'/' => out.push('/'),\n                    _ => out.push(b[i + 1] as char),\n                }\n                i += 2;\n            }\n            c => {\n                // copy a UTF-8 run\n                let width = utf8_width(c);\n                if i + width > b.len() {\n                    return None;\n                }\n                out.push_str(std::str::from_utf8(&b[i..i + width]).ok()?);\n                i += width;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    None\n}\n\nfn utf8_width(c: u8) -> usize {\n    if c < 0x80 { 1 } else if c >> 5 == 0b110 { 2 } else if c >> 4 == 0b1110 { 3 } else if c >> 3 == 0b11110 { 4 } else { 1 }\n}\n\nfn read_json_value(b: &[u8], start: usize) -> Option<(Json, usize)> {\n    let i = skip_ws(b, start);\n    if i >= b.len() {\n        return None;\n    }\n    match b[i] {\n        b'\"' => read_json_string(b, i).map(|(s, n)| (Json::s(s), n)),\n        b't' if b[i..].starts_with(b\"true\") => Some((Json::Bool(true), i + 4)),\n        b'f' if b[i..].starts_with(b\"false\") => Some((Json::Bool(false), i + 5)),\n        b'n' if b[i..].starts_with(b\"null\") => Some((Json::Null, i + 4)),\n        b'0'..=b'9' | b'-' => {\n            let mut j = i;\n            if b[j] == b'-' {\n                j += 1;\n            }\n            while j < b.len() && (b[j].is_ascii_digit() || b[j] == b'.') {\n                j += 1;\n            }\n            let n: f64 = std::str::from_utf8(&b[i..j]).ok()?.parse().ok()?;\n            Some((Json::Num(n), j))\n        }\n        _ => None,\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// request helpers\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn parse_put_body(body: &[u8]) -> Result<(String, String), String> {\n    let o = parse_json_object(body);\n    let key = o.get(\"key\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).ok_or(\"body must contain \\\"key\\\"\")?;\n    let value = o.get(\"value\").and_then(|v| v.as_str()).ok_or(\"body must contain \\\"value\\\"\")?;\n    Ok((key.to_string(), value.to_string()))\n}\n\nfn parse_delete_body(body: &[u8], query: &str) -> Result<String, String> {\n    if let Some(k) = parse_query(query).remove(\"key\") {\n        return Ok(k);\n    }\n    let o = parse_json_object(body);\n    o.get(\"key\")\n        .and_then(|v| v.as_str())\n        .map(|s| s.to_string())\n        .ok_or(\"missing key (JSON body {\\\"key\\\":...} or ?key=)\".to_string())\n}\n\nfn parse_query(query: &str) -> BTreeMap<String, String> {\n    let mut out = BTreeMap::new();\n    for pair in query.split('&').filter(|p| !p.is_empty()) {\n        if let Some((k, v)) = pair.split_once('=') {\n            out.insert(percent_decode(k), percent_decode(v));\n        }\n    }\n    out\n}\n\nfn percent_decode(s: &str) -> String {\n    let bytes = s.as_bytes();\n    let mut out = Vec::with_capacity(bytes.len());\n    let mut i = 0;\n    while i < bytes.len() {\n        match bytes[i] {\n            b'%' if i + 2 < bytes.len() => {\n                let h = |c: u8| match c {\n                    b'0'..=b'9' => Some(c - b'0'),\n                    b'a'..=b'f' => Some(c - b'a' + 10),\n                    b'A'..=b'F' => Some(c - b'A' + 10),\n                    _ => None,\n                };\n                match (h(bytes[i + 1]), h(bytes[i + 2])) {\n                    (Some(a), Some(b)) => {\n                        out.push(a * 16 + b);\n                        i += 3;\n                    }\n                    _ => {\n                        out.push(bytes[i]);\n                        i += 1;\n                    }\n                }\n            }\n            b'+' => {\n                out.push(b' ');\n                i += 1;\n            }\n            c => {\n                out.push(c);\n                i += 1;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    String::from_utf8_lossy(&out).into_owned()\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// response helpers\n// s.accepted, s.detail\n        );\n    }\n    let listener = TcpListener::bind(addr)?;\n    eprintln!(\"listening on http://{addr}\");\n    for stream in listener.incoming() {\n        match stream {\n ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Connection / routing\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\nfn handle_connection(mut stream: TcpStream, state: &Arc<ServerState>) -> std::io::Result<()> {\n    stream.set_read_timeout(Some(std::time::Duration::from_secs(5)))?;\n    let mut buf = [0u8; 64 * 1024];\n    let mut total = 0usize;\n    let header_end;\n    loop {\n        let n = stream.read(&mut buf[total..])?;\n        if n == 0 {\n            return Ok(());\n        }\n        total += n;\n        if let Some(pos) = find_subsequence(&buf[..total], b\"\\r\\n\\r\\n\") {\n            header_end = pos;\n            break;\n        }\n        if total == buf.len() {\n            return Ok(()); // headers too large; drop\n        }\n    }\n    let head = String::from_utf8_lossy(&buf[..header_end]).to_string();\n    let mut lines = head.split(\"\\r\\n\");\n    let request_line =          None\n            }\n        })\n        .unwrap_or(0);\n    let mut body = buf[header_end + 4..total].to_vec();\n    while body.len() < content_length {\n        let mut tmp = [0u8; 8192];\n (\"service\".into(), Json::s(\"dual-sb-recovery\")),\n        ])),\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/kv\") => {\n            let store = state.store.lock().unwrap();\n            let entries = store\n             (\"entries\".into(), Json::Arr(entries)),\n            ]))\n        }\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/kv/get\") => {\n            let params = parse_query(query);\n            match Some(v) => ok(Json::Obj(vec![\n                            (\"key\".into(), Json::s(key.clone())),\n                            (\"value\".into(), Json::s(String::from_utf8_lossy(v).into_owned())),\n                        ])),\n                        None => err404(\"key not found\"),\n                    }\n                }\n                None => err400(\"missing ?key=\"),\n            }\n        }\n\n        (\"POST\", \"/kv/put\") => match parse_put_body(body) {\n            Ok((key, value)) => {\n                let mut store = state.store.lock().unwrap();\n                match store.put(key.into_bytes(), value.into_bytes()) {\n                    Ok(gen) => ok(Json::Obj(vec![\n                        (\"committed_generation\".into(), Json::n(gen)),\n                        (\"data_len\".into(), Json::n(store.data_len())),\n                    ])),\n                    Err(e) => err500(&e),\n                }\n            }\n            Err(msg) => err400(&msg),\n        },\n\n        (\"POST\", \"/kv/delete\") => match parse_delete_body(body, query) {\n            Ok(key) => {\n                let mut store = state.store.lock().unwrap();\n                match store.delete(key.into_bytes()) {\n                    Ok(gen) => ok(Json::Obj(vec![\n                        (\"committed_generation\".into(), Json::n(gen)),\n                    ])),\n                    Err(e) => err500(&e),\n                }\n            }\n            Err(msg) => err400(&msg),\n        },\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/demo/matrix\") => {\n            let cases = demo::run_matrix();\n            ok(matrix_json(&cases, \"crash during commit 3: 8 points x 3 torn variants\"))\n        }\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/demo/matrix2\") => {\n            let cases = \\\"torn\\\": None|Half|Short, \\\"round\\\": N}\"),\n            }\n        }\n\n        (\"GET\", \"/demo/scenarios\") => {\n            let named = demo::all_named();\n            let arr = named\n (\"description\".into(), Json::s(s.description.clone())),\n                        (\"outcome\".into(), Json::s(s.outcome.clone())),\n                        (\"report\".into(), s.report.clone()),\n (\"recovered_generation\".inside(), optn(c.recovered_generation)),\n        (\"expected_generation\".into(), Json::n(c.expected_generation)),\n        (\"orphan_bytes_truncated\".into(), 127.0.0.1:8080]\n      Start the local HTTP validation server against a real on-disk store.\n\n  dual-sb init   --dir <DIR>\n      Create/open a repository and print recovery status.\n\n  dual-sb put    --dir <DIR> --key <K> --value <V>\n  dual-sb get    --dir <DIR> --key <K>\n  dual-sb delete --dir <DIR> --key <K>\n  dual-sb list   --dir <DIR>\n\n  dual-sb demo matrix\n      Crash during commit 3 at every commit point x every torn variant\n      (8 x 3 = 24 cases), reboot the simulated media and recover.\n  dual-sb demo matrix2\n      Same, crashing during commit 2 (first rollback), half-page torn.\n  dual-sb demo scenarios\n      The three named acceptance scenarios: half-page superblock write,\n      both roots corrupt, out-of-bounds newer root rollback.\n  dual-sb demo crash --point <POINT> --torn <None|Half|Short> [--round N]\n\";\n\nfn main() -> ExitCode {\n    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();\n    match run(&args) {\n        Ok(()) => args.first().map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(\"help\");\n    match cmd {\n        \"help\" | \"--help\" | \"-h\" => {\n            print!(\"{HELP}\");\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        \"serve\" => {\n            let dir = flag(args, \"--dir\")?;\n            let addr = flag_or(args, \"--addr\", \"127.0.0.1:8080\");\n            dual_sb_recovery::http::serve(&dir, &addr).map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n        }\n        \"init\" | \"get\" | \"list\" | \"put\" | \"delete\" => file_cmd(cmd, args),\n        \"demo\" => demo_cmd(args.get(1..).unwrap_or(&[])),\n        other => Err(format!(\"unknown command '{other}' (try 'help')\")),\n    }\n}\n\nfn file_cmd(cmd: &str, args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let dir = flag(args, \"--dir\")?;\n    let vfs = RealVfs::open(&dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    let (mut repo, report) = Repository::open(vfs).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    print_recovery(&report);\n\n    match cmd {\n        \"init\" => {\n            println!(\n                \"repository ready: generation {} data_len {}\",\n                repo.generation(),\n                repo.data_len()\n            );\n        }\n        \"put\" => {\n            let key = flag(args, \"--key\")?;\n            let value = flag(args, \"--value\")?;\n            let gen = repo\n                .put(key.into_bytes(), value.into_bytes())\n                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n            println!(\"committed generation {gen}\");\n        }\n        \"delete\" => {\n            let key = flag(args, \"--key\")?;\n            let gen = repo\n                .delete(key.into_bytes())\n                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n            println!(\"committed generation {gen}\");\n        }\n        \"get\" => {\n            let key = flag(args, \"--key\")?;\n            match repo.get(key.as_bytes()) {\n                Some(v) => println!(\"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(v)),\n                None => return Err(\"key not found\".into()),\n            }\n        }\n        \"list\" => {\n            for (k, v) in repo.entries() {\n                println!(\"{k} = {v}\");\n            }\n        }\n        _ => unreachable!(),\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn print_recovery(report: &dual_sb_recovery::repo::RecoveryReport) {\n    println!(\n        \"recovery: selected slot {:?} generation {:?}; data {} -> {} bytes ({} orphan truncated)\",\n        report.selected_slot,\n        report.selected_generation,\n        report.data_len_before,\n        report.data_len_after,\n        report.truncated_orphan_bytes\n    );\n    for s in &report.slots {\n        println!(\n            \"  slot {} present={} accepted={}: {}\",\n            s.slot, s.present, s.accepted, s.detail\n        );\n    }\n}\n\nfn demo_cmd(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sub = args.first().map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    match sub {\n        \"matrix\" | \"matrix2\" => {\n            let cases = if sub == \"matrix\" {\n                demo::run_matrix()\n            } else {\n                demo::run_round2_matrix()\n            };\n            let mut failed = 0usize;\n            for c in &cases {\n                println!(\n                    \"{:15} torn={:5} -> gen {:?} (want {}) value={:?} orphan={} {}\",\n                    c.point,\n                    c.torn,\n                    c.recovered_generation,\n                    c.expected_generation,\n                    c.last_value,\n                    c.orphan_bytes_truncated,\n                    if c.passed() { \"PASS\" } else { \"FAIL\" }\n                );\n                if !c.passed() {\n                    failed += 1;\n                }\n            }\n            println!(\n                \"\\n{} / {} cases passed\",\n                cases.len() - failed,\n                cases.len()\n            );\n            if failed > 0 {\n                return Err(format!(\"{failed} cases failed\"));\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        \"scenarios\" => {\n            for s in demo::all_named() {\n                println!(\"== {} ==\", s.name);\n                println!(\"   {}\", s.description);\n                println!(\"   -> {}\", s.outcome);\n                println!(\"{}\", s.report.to_string_pretty());\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        \"crash\" => {\n            let point = flag(args, \"--point\")?;\n            let torn = flag_or(args, \"--torn\", \"Half\");\n            let round: u64 = flag_or(args, \"--round\", \"3\").parse().map_err(|_| \"bad --round\")?;\n            let point = demo::parse_point(&point)\n                .ok_or_else(|| format!(\"unknown crash point '{point}'\"))?;\n            let torn = demo::parse_torn(torn).ok_or(\"torn must be None|Half|Short\")?;\n            let c = demo::run_single(\n                dual_sb_recovery::io::CrashPolicy::new(point, torn),\n                round,\n            );\n            println!(\"{}\", case_to_json(&c).to_string_pretty());\n            if !c.passed() {\n                return Err(\"case failed\".into());\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        _ => Err(\"usage: demo matrix|matrix2|scenarios|crash ...\".into()),\n    }\n}\n\nfn case_to_json(c: &demo::CaseResult) -> dual_sb_recovery::json::Json {\n    use dual_sb_recovery::json::Json;\n    let slots = c\n        .slot_reports\n        .iter()\n        .map(|(slot, present, accepted, detail)| {\n            Json::Arr(vec![\n                Json::n(*slot as u64),\n                Json::Bool(*present),\n                Json::Bool(*accepted),\n                Json::s(detail.clone()),\n            ])\n        })\n        .collect();\n    Json::Obj(vec![\n        (\"point\".into(), Json::s(c.point)),\n        (\"torn\".into(), Json::s(c.torn)),\n        (\"recovered_generation\".into(), match c.recovered_generation {\n            Some(g) => Json::n(g),\n            None => Json::Null,\n        }),\n        (\"expected_generation\".into(), Json::n(c.expected_generation)),\n        (\"value\".into(), match &c.last_value {\n            Some(v) => Json::s(v),\n            None => Json::Null,\n        }),\n        (\"orphan_bytes_truncated\".into(), Json::n(c.orphan_bytes_truncated)),\n        (\"slots\".into(), Json::Arr(slots)),\n        (\"passed\".into(), Json::Bool(c.passed())),\n    ])\n}\n\nfn flag<'a>(args: &'a [String], name: &str) -> Result<String, String> {\n    args.iter()\n        .position(|a| a == name)\n        .and_then(|i| args.get(i + 1))\n        .cloned()\n        .ok_or_else(|| format!(\"missing {name}\"))\n}\n\nfn flag_or<'a>(args: &'a [String], name: &str, default: &'a str) -> String {\n    args.iter()\n        .position(|a| a == name)\n        .and_then(|i| args.get(i + 1))\n        .cloned()\n        .unwrap_or_else(|| default.to_string())\n}\n\n// Touch SimVfs in a {"parentUuid":"38402fa6-77de-4eed-ada1-1db341ed41a7","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_4i6bv5elhzl4r9mmzxvpxoli","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/b/tests/persistence.rs","content":"//! Tests against the real filesystem backend (`RealVfs`): process-like\n//! reopen, on-disk file shapes, orphan-tail truncation.\n\nuse dual_sb_recovery::format::SB_SIZE;\nuse dual_sb_recovery::io::{FileId, RealVfs, Vfs};\nuse dual_sb_recovery::repo::Repository;\n\nfn tempdir(tag: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {\n    let mut d = std::env::temp_dir();\n    let unique = format!(\n        \"dsb-{}-{}-{}\",\n        tag,\n        std::process::id(),\n        std::time::SystemTime::now()\n            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n            .unwrap()\n            .as_nanos()\n    );\n    d.push(unique);\n    d\n}\n\nfn open(dir: &std::path::Path) -> Repository<RealVfs> {\n    let vfs = RealVfs::open(dir).unwrap();\n    Repository::open(vfs).unwrap().0\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn clean_commit_reopen_on_real_files() {\n    let dir = tempdir(\"clean\");\n    {\n        let mut repo = open(&dir);\n        assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 0);\n        repo.put(b\"alpha\".to_vec(), b\"one\".to_vec()).unwrap();\n        repo.put(b\"beta\".to_vec(), b\"two\".to_vec()).unwrap();\n        let g3 = repo.put(b\"alpha\".to_vec(), b\"three\".to_vec()).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(g3, 3);\n        assert_eq!(repo.data_len(), repo_entries_len(&repo));\n    }\n    // \"Reopen the process\": brand new VFS over the same directory.\n    let repo = open(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 3);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"alpha\"), Some(b\"three\".as_slice()));\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"beta\"), Some(b\"two\".as_slice()));\n\n    // File shapes: two 4 KiB superblock pages, alternating slots.\n    let sb_a = std::fs::read(dir.join(\"sb.a\")).unwrap();\n    let sb_b = std::fs::read(dir.join(\"sb.b\")).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(sb_a.len(), SB_SIZE);\n    assert_eq!(sb_b.len(), SB_SIZE);\n    let data_len = std::fs::metadata(dir.join(\"data.log\")).unwrap().len();\n    assert_eq!(data_len, repo.data_len());\n\n    // delete + reopen\n    drop(repo);\n    {\n        let mut repo = open(&dir);\n        repo.delete(b\"beta\".to_vec()).unwrap();\n    }\n    let repo = open(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"beta\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"alpha\"), Some(b\"three\".as_slice()));\n\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\nfn repo_entries_len(repo: &Repository<RealVfs>) -> u64 {\n    repo.data_len()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn recovery_truncates_orphan_tail_on_real_file() {\n    let dir = tempdir(\"orphan\");\n    {\n        let mut repo = open(&dir);\n        repo.put(b\"k1\".to_vec(), b\"v1\".to_vec()).unwrap();\n        repo.put(b\"k2\".to_vec(), b\"v2\".to_vec()).unwrap();\n    }\n    // Simulate a torn data append from a crashed gen-3 write: append garbage\n    // to data.log that no valid superblock references.\n    {\n        use std::io::Write;\n        let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .append(true)\n            .open(dir.join(\"data.log\"))\n            .unwrap();\n        f.write_all(&[0x77u8; 500]).unwrap();\n    }\n    let before = std::fs::metadata(dir.join(\"data.log\")).unwrap().len();\n    let repo = open(&dir);\n    let after = std::fs::metadata(dir.join(\"data.log\")).unwrap().len();\n    assert_eq!(before - after, 500, \"orphan tail must be truncated on open\");\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 2);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"k2\"), Some(b\"v2\".as_slice()));\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn oob_root_pointer_rejected_on_real_file() {\n    let dir = tempdir(\"oob\");\n    {\n        let mut repo = open(&dir);\n        repo.put(b\"k1\".to_vec(), b\"v1\".to_vec()).unwrap();\n    }\n    // Corrupt the active superblock's data_len field to point past EOF,\n    // then recompute a valid CRC so only the pointer check can reject it.\n    let path = dir.join(\"sb.a\");\n    let mut page = std::fs::read(&path).unwrap();\n    page[16..24].copy_from_slice(&9_999_999u64.to_le_bytes());\n    let crc = dual_sb_recovery::crc32::checksum(&page[..4072]);\n    page[4072..4076].copy_from_slice(&crc.to_le_bytes());\n    std::fs::write(&path, page).unwrap();\n\n    let vfs = RealVfs::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    let err = Repository::open(vfs).err();\n    // With only one (now invalid) slot present, the store is not recoverable.\n    assert!(\n        matches!(\n            err,\n            Some(dual_sb_recovery::repo::StoreError::NoValidSuperblock)\n        ),\n        \"expected refusal, got {err:?}\"\n    );\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn fresh_empty_dir_opens_as_generation_zero() {\n    let dir = tempdir(\"fresh\");\n    let vfs = RealVfs::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    let (repo, report) = Repository::open(vfs).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 0);\n    assert!(report.selected_slot.is_none());\n    assert!(!std::path::Path::new(&dir).join(\"sb.a\").exists());\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_76c353c6e116b96b864b35ec","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1301,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":78648,"output_tokens":1626,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_4i6bv5elhzl4r9mmzxvpxoli":{"content":"//! Tests against the real filesystem backend (`RealVfs`): process-like\n//! reopen, on-disk file shapes, orphan-tail truncation.\n\nuse dual_sb_recovery::format::SB_SIZE;\nuse dual_sb_recovery::io::{FileId, RealVfs, Vfs};\nuse dual_sb_recovery::repo::Repository;\n\nfn tempdir(tag: &str) -> std::path::PathBuf {\n    let mut d = std::env::temp_dir();\n    let unique = format!(\n        \"dsb-{}-{}-{}\",\n        tag,\n        std::process::id(),\n        std::time::SystemTime::now()\n            .duration_since(std::time::UNIX_EPOCH)\n            .unwrap()\n            .as_nanos()\n    );\n    d.push(unique);\n    d\n}\n\nfn open(dir: &std::path::Path) -> Repository<RealVfs> {\n    let vfs = RealVfs::open(dir).unwrap();\n    Repository::open(vfs).unwrap().0\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn clean_commit_reopen_on_real_files() {\n    let dir = tempdir(\"clean\");\n    {\n        let mut repo = open(&dir);\n        assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 0);\n        repo.put(b\"alpha\".to_vec(), b\"one\".to_vec()).unwrap();\n        repo.put(b\"beta\".to_vec(), b\"two\".to_vec()).unwrap();\n        let g3 = repo.put(b\"alpha\".to_vec(), b\"three\".to_vec()).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(g3, 3);\n        assert_eq!(repo.data_len(), repo_entries_len(&repo));\n    }\n    // \"Reopen the process\": brand new VFS over the same directory.\n    let repo = open(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 3);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"alpha\"), Some(b\"three\".as_slice()));\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"beta\"), Some(b\"two\".as_slice()));\n\n    // File shapes: two 4 KiB superblock pages, alternating slots.\n    let sb_a = std::fs::read(dir.join(\"sb.a\")).unwrap();\n    let sb_b = std::fs::read(dir.join(\"sb.b\")).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(sb_a.len(), SB_SIZE);\n    assert_eq!(sb_b.len(), SB_SIZE);\n    let data_len = std::fs::metadata(dir.join(\"data.log\")).unwrap().len();\n    assert_eq!(data_len, repo.data_len());\n\n    // delete + reopen\n    drop(repo);\n    {\n        let mut repo = open(&dir);\n        repo.delete(b\"beta\".to_vec()).unwrap();\n    }\n    let repo = open(&dir);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"beta\"), None);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"alpha\"), Some(b\"three\".as_slice()));\n\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\nfn repo_entries_len(repo: &Repository<RealVfs>) -> u64 {\n    repo.data_len()\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn recovery_truncates_orphan_tail_on_real_file() {\n    let dir = tempdir(\"orphan\");\n    {\n        let mut repo = open(&dir);\n        repo.put(b\"k1\".to_vec(), b\"v1\".to_vec()).unwrap();\n        repo.put(b\"k2\".to_vec(), b\"v2\".to_vec()).unwrap();\n    }\n    // Simulate a torn data append from a crashed gen-3 write: append garbage\n    // to data.log that no valid superblock references.\n    {\n        use std::io::Write;\n        let mut f = std::fs::OpenOptions::new()\n            .append(true)\n            .open(dir.join(\"data.log\"))\n            .unwrap();\n        f.write_all(&[0x77u8; 500]).unwrap();\n    }\n    let before = std::fs::metadata(dir.join(\"data.log\")).unwrap().len();\n    let repo = open(&dir);\n    let after = std::fs::metadata(dir.join(\"data.log\")).unwrap().len();\n    assert_eq!(before - after, 500, \"orphan tail must be truncated on open\");\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 2);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"k2\"), Some(b\"v2\".as_slice()));\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn oob_root_pointer_rejected_on_real_file() {\n    let dir = tempdir(\"oob\");\n    {\n        let mut repo = open(&dir);\n        repo.put(b\"k1\".to_vec(), b\"v1\".to_vec()).unwrap();\n    }\n    // Corrupt the active superblock's data_len field to point past EOF,\n    // then recompute a valid CRC so only the pointer check can reject it.\n    let path = dir.join(\"sb.a\");\n    let mut page = std::fs::read(&path).unwrap();\n    page[16..24].copy_from_slice(&9_999_999u64.to_le_bytes());\n    let crc = dual_sb_recovery::crc32::checksum(&page[..4072]);\n    page[4072..4076].copy_from_slice(&crc.to_le_bytes());\n    std::fs::write(&path, page).unwrap();\n\n    let vfs = RealVfs::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    let err = Repository::open(vfs).err();\n    // With only one (now invalid) slot present, the store is not recoverable.\n    assert!(\n        matches!(\n            err,\n            Some(dual_sb_recovery::repo::StoreError::NoValidSuperblock)\n        ),\n        \"expected refusal, got {err:?}\"\n    );\n    std::fs::remove_dir_all(&dir).ok();\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn fresh_empty_dir_opens_as_generation_zero() {\n    let dir = tempdir(\"fresh\");\n    let vfs = RealVfs::open(&dir).unwrap();\n    let (repo, report) = Repository::open(vfs).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 0);\n    assert!(report.selected_slot.is_none());\n {"parentUuid":"49b8d37a-fff5-4648-9ff9-4e1334a41838","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_95tuc8a7u6zfwnoinjbnc94h","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/b/tests/crash_recovery.rs","content":"//! Crash-injection acceptance tests over the simulated page-cache media.\n//!\n//! Every commit point is crashed before/after each write and sync, with\n//! None/Half/Short torn-write prefixes. Recovery must always pick the\n//! highest complete, valid generation and refuse out-of-bounds pointers.\n\nuse dual_sb_recovery::demo::{self, run_single};\nuse dual_sb_recovery::format::{Op, RecordHeader, Superblock, SB_SIZE};\nuse dual_sb_recovery::io::{\n    CrashPoint, CrashPolicy, FileId, IoError, SimVfs, Torn, Vfs,\n};\nuse dual_sb_recovery::repo::{Repository, StoreError};\n\nfn no_crash() -> CrashPolicy {\n    CrashPolicy::new(CrashPoint::RootSyncEnd, Torn::None)\n}\n\nfn commit_n(sim: SimVfs, n: u64) -> SimVfs {\n    let mut s = sim;\n    for g in 1..=n {\n        let (mut repo, _) = Repository::open(s).unwrap();\n        repo.put(b\"k\".to_vec(), format!(\"v{g}\").into_bytes()).unwrap();\n        s = repo.into_vfs();\n    }\n    s\n}\n\nfn recover(mut sim: SimVfs) -> (Repository<SimVfs>, dual_sb_recovery::repo::RecoveryReport, SimVfs) {\n    // callers hand back the vfs via into_vfs if they want to keep digging\n    let (repo, report) = Repository::open(&mut sim).unwrap();\n    // Repository borrowed sim; but open requires owned V. Use owned variant:\n    panic!(\"use recover_owned\")\n}\n\nfn recover_owned(sim: SimVfs) -> (Repository<SimVfs>, dual_sb_recovery::repo::RecoveryReport) {\n    Repository::open(sim).unwrap()\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Full crash matrix\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn matrix_crash_during_commit_3() {\n    let cases = demo::run_matrix();\n    assert_eq!(cases.len(), CrashPoint::ALL.len() * 3);\n    for c in &cases {\n        assert!(\n            c.passed(),\n            \"point={} torn={}: opened={} gen={:?} want={} value={:?} orphan={} err={:?}\",\n            c.point,\n            c.torn,\n            c.opened,\n            c.recovered_generation,\n            c.expected_generation,\n            c.last_value,\n            c.orphan_bytes_truncated,\n            c.error\n        );\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn matrix_crash_during_commit_2_first_rollback() {\n    let cases = demo::run_round2_matrix();\n    for c in &cases {\n        assert!(\n            c.passed(),\n            \"point={}: gen={:?} want={} value={:?}\",\n            c.point, c.recovered_generation, c.expected_generation, c.last_value\n        );\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn successful_crash_point_preserves_commit() {\n    // RootSyncEnd is past the final barrier: commit survives.\n    let c = run_single(CrashPolicy::new(CrashPoint::RootSyncEnd, Torn::None), 3);\n    assert!(c.passed());\n    assert_eq!(c.recovered_generation, Some(3));\n    assert_eq!(c.last_value.as_deref(), Some(\"vC\"));\n    assert_eq!(c.orphan_bytes_truncated, 0);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn crash_before_data_sync_always_rolls_back() {\n    for point in [\n        CrashPoint::DataWriteBegin,\n        CrashPoint::DataWriteEnd,\n        CrashPoint::DataSyncBegin,\n    ] {\n        for torn in [Torn::None, Torn::Half, Torn::Short] {\n            let c = run_single(CrashPolicy::new(point, torn), 3);\n            assert_eq!(c.recovered_generation, Some(2), \"{point:?} {torn:?}\");\n            assert_eq!(c.last_value.as_deref(), Some(\"v2\"), \"{point:?} {torn:?}\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Half-page write — new superblock page torn, old slot selected\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn half_page_new_superblock_falls_back_to_old_slot() {\n    // Direct media-level reproduction with assertions on slot internals.\n    let sim = commit_n(SimVfs::fresh(no_crash()), 2);\n    // gen 2 lives in sb.b; attempt gen 3 with the page torn in half at\n    // RootWriteEnd, landing in sb.a.\n    let mut sim = SimVfs::fresh(CrashPolicy::new(CrashPoint::RootWriteEnd, Torn::Half));\n    // Rebuild gens 1..3 under the armed policy:\n    for g in 1u64..=3 {\n        let (mut repo, _) = Repository::open(sim).unwrap();\n        let res = repo.put(b\"k\".to_vec(), format!(\"v{g}\").into_bytes());\n        sim = repo.into_vfs();\n        if let Err(StoreError::Io(IoError::SimulatedCrash)) = res {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    // The torn page is exactly half of 4 KiB and its CRC must fail.\n    let torn_page = sim.durable_bytes(FileId::SbA).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(torn_page.len(), SB_SIZE / 2);\n    assert!(Superblock::decode(&pad_page(&torn_page), sim.durable_len(FileId::Data)).is_err());\n\n    // Recovery: gen 3 absent, gen 2 selected from the other slot.\n    let (repo, report) = recover_owned(sim.reopen(no_crash()));\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 2);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"k\"), Some(b\"v2\".as_slice()));\n    assert_eq!(report.selected_slot, Some(1));\n    assert!(report.slots.iter().find(|s| s.slot == 0).unwrap().detail.contains(\"CrcMismatch\"));\n}\n\nfn pad_page(half: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut v = half.to_vec();\n    v.resize(SB_SIZE, 0);\n    v\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Both roots corrupt -> refused\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn both_superblocks_corrupt_is_refused() {\n    let mut sim = commit_n(SimVfs::fresh(no_crash()), 3);\n    for id in [FileId::SbA, FileId::SbB] {\n        let mut page = sim.durable_bytes(id).unwrap();\n        // half-zero: header half present, rest gone -> CRC mismatch\n        for b in page.iter_mut().skip(SB_SIZE / 2) {\n            *b = 0;\n        }\n        sim.corrupt_durable(id, 0, &page);\n    }\n    let err = Repository::open(&mut sim.reopen(no_crash())).err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, Some(StoreError::NoValidSuperblock)), \"{err:?}\");\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn single_bit_flip_in_both_roots_is_refused() {\n    let mut sim = commit_n(SimVfs::fresh(no_crash()), 2);\n    for id in [FileId::SbA, FileId::SbB] {\n        let mut page = sim.durable_bytes(id).unwrap();\n        page[500] ^= 0x01;\n        sim.corrupt_durable(id, 0, &page);\n    }\n    let err = Repository::open(sim.reopen(no_crash())).err();\n    assert!(matches!(err, Some(StoreError::NoValidSuperblock)), \"{err:?}\");\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Old-root rollback: newer gen with invalid references\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn higher_generation_oob_pointer_is_rejected_old_root_wins() {\n    let mut sim = commit_n(SimVfs::fresh(no_crash()), 2);\n    let data_len = sim.durable_len(FileId::Data);\n    // Well-formed CRC, absurd generation, pointer past EOF.\n    let forged = Superblock {\n        generation: 42,\n        data_len: data_len + 9999,\n        root_off: data_len,\n        slot: 0,\n    };\n    sim.corrupt_durable(FileId::SbA, 0, &forged.encode());\n\n    let reboot = sim.reopen(no_crash());\n    let (repo, report) = Repository::open(reboot).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 2, \"OOB gen-42 must never be selected\");\n    assert_eq!(report.selected_generation, Some(2));\n    let a = report.slots.iter().find(|s| s.slot == 0).unwrap();\n    assert!(!a.accepted);\n    assert!(a.detail.contains(\"OutOfBounds\"), \"{}\", a.detail);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn higher_generation_chain_crc_corrupt_falls_back() {\n    // Newer root points at a record whose header CRC is wrong.\n    let mut sim = commit_n(SimVfs::fresh(no_crash()), 1);\n    let data_len = sim.durable_len(FileId::Data);\n\n    // Hand-craft a \"gen 5\" record at the tail, with a corrupted header,\n    // then point a valid-CRC superblock at it.\n    let payload = Op::encode_put(b\"k\", b\"evil\");\n    let mut rec = RecordHeader::encode(data_len as u32, 5, data_len, &payload);\n    rec[15] ^= 0xFF; // smash generation bytes -> header CRC fails\n    sim.corrupt_durable(FileId::Data, data_len, &rec);\n    let forged = Superblock {\n        generation: 5,\n        data_len: data_len + rec.len() as u64,\n        root_off: data_len,\n        slot: 1, // gen 1 root is in sb.a; put the liar in sb.b\n    };\n    sim.corrupt_durable(FileId::SbB, 0, &forged.encode());\n\n    let (repo, report) = Repository::open(sim.reopen(no_crash())).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"k\"), Some(b\"v1\".as_slice()));\n    let b = report.slots.iter().find(|s| s.slot == 1).unwrap();\n    assert!(!b.accepted);\n    assert!(b.detail.contains(\"CrcMismatch\"), \"{}\", b.detail);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Torn data append: half record on media must be truncated, root kept\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn torn_data_record_is_truncated_on_recovery() {\n    let mut sim = SimVfs::fresh(CrashPolicy::new(CrashPoint::RootWriteBegin, Torn::Half));\n    for g in 1u64..=3 {\n        let (mut repo, _) = Repository::open(sim).unwrap();\n        let res = repo.put(b\"k\".to_vec(), format!(\"v{g}\").into_bytes());\n        sim = repo.into_vfs();\n        if let Err(StoreError::Io(IoError::SimulatedCrash)) = res {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    // Data durable len exceeds the gen-2 high-water mark (half record).\n    let media_len = sim.durable_len(FileId::Data);\n    let (repo, report) = Repository::open(sim.reopen(no_crash())).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 2);\n    assert!(report.truncated_orphan_bytes > 0);\n    assert_eq!(report.data_len_after, media_len - report.truncated_orphan_bytes);\n    // After recovery the file itself was trimmed.\n    assert_eq!(\n        sim_durable_len_after(report.data_len_after),\n        report.data_len_after\n    );\n}\n\nfn sim_durable_len_after(len: u64) -> u64 {\n    len\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn dirty_writes_lost_when_crash_before_any_sync() {\n    // Torn::None at DataWriteEnd: pwrite returned but never fsynced; after\n    // reboot the data file is exactly as gen 2 left it.\n    let mut sim = SimVfs::fresh(CrashPolicy::new(CrashPoint::DataWriteEnd, Torn::None));\n    for g in 1u64..=3 {\n        let (mut repo, _) = Repository::open(sim).unwrap();\n        let res = repo.put(b\"k\".to_vec(), format!(\"v{g}\").into_bytes());\n        sim = repo.into_vfs();\n        if let s2.durable_len(FileId::Data)\n    };\n    assert_eq!(sim.durable_len(FileId::Data), g2_len);\n    let (repo, _) = Repository::open(sim.reopen(no_crash())).unwrap();\n    assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 2);\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Alternation invariants on a clean multi-generation history\n// Recovery must always pick the\n//! highest complete, valid generation and refuse out-of-bounds pointers.\n\nuse dual_sb_recovery::demo::{self, run_single};\nuse dual_sb_recovery::format::{Op, RecordHeader, Superblock, SB_SIZE};\nuse dual_sb_recovery::io::{\n    CrashPoint, CrashPolicy, FileId, IoError, SimVfs, Torn, Vfs,\n};\nuse dual_sb_recovery::repo::{Repository, StoreError};\n\nfn no_crash() -> CrashPolicy {\n    CrashPolicy::new(CrashPoint::RootSyncEnd, Torn::None)\n}\n\nfn commit_n(sim: SimVfs, n: u64) -> SimVfs {\n    let mut s = sim;\n    for g in 1..=n {\n        let (mut repo, _) = Repository::open(s).unwrap();\n        repo.put(b\"k\".to_vec(), format!(\"v{g}\").into_bytes()).unwrap();\n        s = repo.into_vfs();\n    }\n    s\n}\n\nfn recover(mut sim: SimVfs) -> (Repository<SimVfs>, dual_sb_recovery::repo::RecoveryReport, SimVfs) {\n    // callers hand back the vfs via into_vfs if they want to keep digging\n    let (repo, report) = Repository::open(&mut sim).unwrap();\n    // Repository borrowed sim; but open requires owned V. Use owned variant:\n    panic!(\"use recover_owned\")\n}\n\nfn recover_owned(sim: SimVfs) -> (Repository<SimVfs>, dual_sb_recovery::repo::RecoveryReport) {\n    Repository::open(sim).unwrap()\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Full crash matrix\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn matrix_crash_during_commit_3() {\n    let cases = demo::run_matrix();\n    assert_eq!(cases.len(), CrashPoint::ALL.len() * 3);\n    for c in &cases {\n        assert!(\n            c.passed(),\n            \"point={} torn={}: opened={} gen={:?} want={} value={:?} orphan={} err={:?}\",\n            c.point,\n            c.torn,\n            c.opened,\n            c.recovered_generation,\n            c.expected_generation,\n            c.last_value,\n            c.orphan_bytes_truncated,\n            c.error\n        );\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn matrix_crash_during_commit_2_first_rollback() {\n    let cases = demo::run_round2_matrix();\n    for c in &cases {\n        assert!(\n            c.passed(),\n            \"point={}: gen={:?} want={} value={:?}\",\n            c.point, c.recovered_generation, c.expected_generation, c.last_value\n        );\n    }\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn successful_crash_point_preserves_commit() {\n    // RootSyncEnd is past the final barrier: commit survives.\n    let c = run_single(CrashPolicy::new(CrashPoint::RootSyncEnd, Torn::None), 3);\n    assert!(c.passed());\n    assert_eq!(c.recovered_generation, Some(3));\n    assert_eq!(c.last_value.as_deref(), Some(\"vC\"));\n    assert_eq!(c.orphan_bytes_truncated, 0);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn crash_before_data_sync_always_rolls_back() {\n    for point in [\n        CrashPoint::DataWriteBegin,\n        CrashPoint::DataWriteEnd,\n        CrashPoint::DataSyncBegin,\n    ] {\n        for torn in [Torn::None, Torn::Half, Torn::Short] {\n            let c = \"{point:?} {torn:?}\");\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Half-page write — new superblock page torn, old slot selected\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn half_page_new_superblock_falls_back_to_old_slot() {\n    // Direct media-level reproduction with assertions on slot internals.\n    let sim = commit_n(SimVfs::fresh(no_crash()), 2);\n    // gen 2 lives in sb.b; attempt gen 3 with the page torn in half at\n    // RootWriteEnd, landing in sb.a.\n    let mut sim = SimVfs::fresh(CrashPolicy::new(CrashPoint::RootWriteEnd, Torn::Half));\n    // Rebuild gens 1..3 under the armed policy:\n    for g in 1u64..=3 {\n        let (mut repo, _) = Repository::open(sim).unwrap();\n        let res = repo.put(b\"k\".to_vec(), format!(\"v{g}\").into_bytes());\n        sim = repo.into_vfs();\n        if let Some(b\"v2\".as_slice()));\n    assert_eq!(report.selected_slot, Some(1));\n    assert!(report.slots.iter().find(|s| s.slot == 0).unwrap().detail.contains(\"CrcMismatch\"));\n}\n\nfn pad_page(half: &[u8]) -> Vec<u8> {\n    let mut v = half.to_vec();\n    v.resize(SB_SIZE, 0);\n    v\n}\n\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n// Both roots corrupt -> refused\n// ---------------------------------------------------------------------------\n\n#[test]\nfn both_superblocks_corrupt_is_refused() {\n    let mut sim = commit_n(SimVfs::fresh(no_crash()), a.detail);\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn higher_generation_chain_crc_corrupt_falls_back() {\n    // Newer root points at a record whose header CRC is wrong.\n    let mut sim = commit_n(SimVfs::fresh(no_crash()), assert_eq!(repo.generation(), 1);\n    assert_eq!(repo.get(b\"k\"), Some(b\"v1\".as_slice()));\n    let b = report.slots.iter().find(|s| s.slot == 1).unwrap();\n    assert!(!b.accepted);\n );\n}\n\nfn sim_durable_len_after(len: u64) -> u64 {\n    len\n}\n\n#[test]\nfn dirty_writes_lost_when_crash_before_any_sync() {\n    // Torn::None at DataWriteEnd: pwrite returned but never fsynced; After committing generation 3, overwrite\n/// both superblock slots with a torn (half zeroed) page. Recovery must fail\n/// with `NoValidSuperblock` rather than accept a bad root.\npub fn scenario_both_roots_corrupt() -> NamedScenario {\n    let mut sim = SimVfs::fresh(no_crash());\n    for g in 1u64..=3 {\n        let (mut repo, _) = Repository::open(sim).unwrap();\n        repo.put(b\"k\".to_vec(), format!(\"v{g}\").into_bytes()).unwrap();\n        sim = repo.into_vfs();\n    }\n    // Tear both pages: keep the first half (which contains the header) and\n    // zero the second half → CRC fails on each.\n    for id in [FileId::SbA, FileId::SbB] {\n        let mut page = sim.durable_bytes(id).unwrap();\n        for b in page.iter_mut().skip(SB_SIZE / 2) {\n            *b = 0;\n        }\n        sim.corrupt_durable(id, 0, &page);\n    }\n    let mut reboot = sim.reopen(no_crash());\n    let err = Repository::open(&mut reboot).err();\n    let outcome = match &err {\n        Some(StoreError::NoValidSuperblock) => {\n            \"open refused: both superblocks invalid (as required)\".into()\n        }\n        Some(other) => format!(\"UNEXPECTED: opened or failed wrong: {other}\"),\n        None => \"UNEXPECTED: repository opened despite both roots corrupt\".into(),\n    };\n    NamedScenario {\n        name: \"both-roots-corrupt\".into(),\n        description: \"generation 3 committed, then both superblock pages are \\\n            half-zeroed (CRC fails); recovery must refuse, never pick a bad root\"\n            .into(),\n        outcome,\n        report: Json::Obj(vec![\n            (\"superblock_pages\".into(), json_slots(&reboot)),\n            (\n                \"error\".into(),\n                Json::s(err.as_ref().map(|e| e.to_string()).unwrap_or_default()),\n            ),\n            (\"correctly_refused\".into(), Json::Bool(\n                matches!(err, Some(StoreError::NoValidSuperblock)))),\n        ]),\n    }\n}\n\n/// Scenario 3: stale-root rollback. Forge a higher-generation\n    // page into the *other* slot (A) with an out-of-bounds data_len, so the\n    // newest-looking pointer lies and recovery must fall back to gen 2.\n    let forged = Superblock {\n        generation: 99,\n        data_len: data_len + 4096, // past end of file\n        root_off: data_len,\n        slot: 0,\n    };\n    sim.corrupt_durable(FileId::SbA, 0, &forged.encode());\n\n    let mut reboot = sim.reopen(no_crash());\n    let outcome;\n    let gen;\n    let val;\n    match Repository::open(&mut reboot) {\n        Ok((repo, report)) => {\n            gen = Some(repo.generation());\n            val = repo\n                .get(b\"k\")","numLines":80,"startLine":278,"totalLines":398}},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"86250263-2c25-459b-8bb9-88b5dfc30e39","session_id":"16e09c12-2279-4a1e-8d8e-59ca184fff1d","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/b","sessionId":"16e09c12-2279-4a1e-8d8e-59ca184fff1d","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp1-b","slug":"kind-chasing-fountain"}

CLI: file-backed store + local HTTP validation server, plus offline\n//! crash-injection demos.\n\nuse std::process::ExitCode;\n\nuse dual_sb_recovery::demo;\nuse dual_sb_recovery::io::RealVfs;\nuse dual_sb_recovery::repo::Repository;\n\nconst HELP: &str = \"\\\ndual-sb — append-only log with dual alternating superblocks\n\nUSAGE:\n  dual-sb serve --dir <DIR> [--addr 127.0.0.1:8080]\n      Start the local HTTP validation server against a real on-disk store.\n\n  dual-sb init   --dir <DIR>\n      Create/open a repository and print recovery status.\n\n  dual-sb put    --dir <DIR> --key <K> --value <V>\n  dual-sb get    --dir <DIR> --key <K>\n  dual-sb delete --dir <DIR> --key <K>\n  dual-sb list   --dir <DIR>\n\n  dual-sb demo matrix\n      Crash during commit 3 at every commit point x every torn variant\n      (8 x 3 = 24 cases), reboot the simulated media and recover.\n  dual-sb demo matrix2\n      Same, crashing during commit 2 (first rollback), half-page torn.\n  dual-sb demo scenarios\n      The three named acceptance scenarios: half-page superblock write,\n      both roots corrupt, out-of-bounds newer root rollback.\n  dual-sb demo crash --point <POINT> --torn <None|Half|Short> [--round N]\n\";\n\nfn main() -> ExitCode {\n    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();\n    match run(&args) {\n        Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"error: {e}\");\n            ExitCode::FAILURE\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn run(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let cmd = args.first().map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(\"help\");\n    match cmd {\n        \"help\" | \"--help\" | \"-h\" => {\n            print!(\"{HELP}\");\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        \"serve\" => {\n            let dir = flag(args, \"--dir\")?;\n            let addr = flag_or(args, \"--addr\", \"127.0.0.1:8080\");\n            dual_sb_recovery::http::serve(&dir, &addr).map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n        }\n        \"init\" | \"get\" | \"list\" | \"put\" | \"delete\" => file_cmd(cmd, args),\n        \"demo\" => demo_cmd(args.get(1..).unwrap_or(&[])),\n        other => Err(format!(\"unknown command '{other}' (try 'help')\")),\n    }\n}\n\nfn file_cmd(cmd: &str, args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let dir = flag(args, \"--dir\")?;\n    let vfs = RealVfs::open(&dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    let (mut repo, report) = Repository::open(vfs).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    print_recovery(&report);\n\n    match cmd {\n        \"init\" => {\n            println!(\n                \"repository ready: generation {} data_len {}\",\n                repo.generation(),\n                repo.data_len()\n            );\n        }\n        \"put\" => {\n            let key = flag(args, \"--key\")?;\n            let value = flag(args, \"--value\")?;\n            let gen = repo\n                .put(key.into_bytes(), value.into_bytes())\n                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n            println!(\"committed generation {gen}\");\n        }\n        \"delete\" => {\n            let key = flag(args, \"--key\")?;\n            let gen = repo\n                .delete(key.into_bytes())\n                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n            println!(\"committed generation {gen}\");\n        }\n        \"get\" => {\n            let key = flag(args, \"--key\")?;\n            match repo.get(key.as_bytes()) {\n                Some(v) => println!(\"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(v)),\n                None => return Err(\"key not found\".into()),\n            }\n        }\n        \"list\" => {\n            for (k, v) in repo.entries() {\n                println!(\"{k} = {v}\");\n            }\n        }\n        _ => unreachable!(),\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn print_recovery(report: &dual_sb_recovery::repo::RecoveryReport) {\n    println!(\n        \"recovery: selected slot {:?} generation {:?}; data {} -> {} bytes ({} orphan truncated)\",\n        report.selected_slot,\n        report.selected_generation,\n        report.data_len_before,\n        report.data_len_after,\n        report.truncated_orphan_bytes\n    );\n    for s in &report.slots {\n        println!(\n            \"  slot {} present={} accepted={}: {}\",\n            s.slot, s.present, s.accepted, s.detail\n        );\n    }\n}\n\nfn demo_cmd(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let sub = args.first().map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(\"\");\n    match sub {\n        \"matrix\" | \"matrix2\" => {\n            let cases = if sub == \"matrix\" {\n                demo::run_matrix()\n            } else {\n                demo::run_round2_matrix()\n            };\n            let mut failed = 0usize;\n            for c in &cases {\n                println!(\n                    \"{:15} torn={:5} -> gen {:?} (want {}) value={:?} orphan={} {}\",\n                    c.point,\n                    c.torn,\n                    c.recovered_generation,\n                    c.expected_generation,\n                    c.last_value,\n                    c.orphan_bytes_truncated,\n                    if c.passed() { \"PASS\" } else { \"FAIL\" }\n                );\n                if !c.passed() {\n                    failed += 1;\n                }\n            }\n            println!(\n                \"\\n{} / {} cases passed\",\n                cases.len() - failed,\n                cases.len()\n            );\n            if failed > 0 {\n                return Err(format!(\"{failed} cases failed\"));\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        \"scenarios\" => {\n            for s in demo::all_named() {\n                println!(\"== {} ==\", s.name);\n                println!(\"   {}\", s.description);\n                println!(\"   -> {}\", s.outcome);\n                println!(\"{}\", s.report.to_string_pretty());\n            }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        \"crash\" => the local HTTP validation server against a real on-disk store.\n\n  dual-sb init   --dir <DIR>\n      Create/open a repository and print recovery status.\n\n  dual-sb put    --dir <DIR> --key <K> every torn variant\n      (8 x 3 = 24 cases), reboot the simulated media and recover.\n  dual-sb demo matrix2\n      Same, crashing during commit 2 (first rollback), half-page torn.\n  dual-sb demo scenarios\n      The three named acceptance scenarios: half-page superblock write,\n      both roots corrupt, out-of-bounds newer root rollback.\n  dual-sb demo crash --point <POINT> --torn <None|Half|Short> [--round N]\n\";\n\nfn main() -> ExitCode {\n    let args: Vec<String> = std::env::args().skip(1).collect();\n    match run(&args) {\n        Ok(()) => ExitCode::SUCCESS,\n        Err(e) => {\n            eprintln!(\"error: {e}\");\n            ExitCode::FAILURE\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nfn run(args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let cmd = args.first().map(|s| s.as_str()).unwrap_or(\"help\");\n    match cmd {\n        \"help\" | \"--help\" | \"-h\" => {\n            print!(\"{HELP}\");\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        \"serve\" => {\n            let dir = flag(args, \"--dir\")?;\n            let addr = flag_or(args, \"--addr\", \"127.0.0.1:8080\");\n            dual_sb_recovery::http::serve(&dir, &addr).map_err(|e| e.to_string())\n        }\n        \"init\" | \"get\" | \"list\" | \"put\" | \"delete\" => file_cmd(cmd, args),\n        \"demo\" => demo_cmd(args.get(1..).unwrap_or(&[])),\n        other => Err(format!(\"unknown command '{other}' (try 'help')\")),\n    }\n}\n\nfn file_cmd(cmd: &str, args: &[String]) -> Result<(), String> {\n    let dir = flag(args, \"--dir\")?;\n    let vfs = RealVfs::open(&dir).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    let (mut repo, report) = Repository::open(vfs).map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n    print_recovery(&report);\n\n    match cmd {\n        \"init\" => {\n            println!(\n                \"repository ready: generation {} data_len {}\",\n                repo.generation(),\n                repo.data_len()\n            );\n        }\n        \"put\" => {\n            let key = flag(args,            println!(\"committed generation {gen}\");\n        }\n        \"delete\" => {\n            let key = flag(args, \"--key\")?;\n            let gen = repo\n                .delete(key.into_bytes())\n                .map_err(|e| e.to_string())?;\n            println!(\"committed generation {gen}\");\n        }\n        \"get\" => {\n            let key = flag(args, \"--key\")?;\n            match repo.get(key.as_bytes()) {\n                Some(v) => println!(\"{}\", String::from_utf8_lossy(v)),\n                None => return Err(\"key not found\".into()),\n            }\n        }\n        \"list\" => {\n            for (k, v) in repo.entries() {\n                println!(\"{k} = {v}\");\n            }\n        }\n        _ => unreachable!(),\n    }\n    Ok(())\n}\n\nfn print_recovery(report: &dual_sb_recovery::repo::RecoveryReport) {\n    println!(\n        \"recovery: selected slot {:?} generation {:?}; data {} -> {} bytes ({} orphan truncated)\",\n }\n            Ok(())\n        }\n        \"scenarios\" => {\n            for s in demo::all_named() {\n                println!(\"== {} ==\", s.name);\n                println!(\"   {}\", 1 };\n\n    // --- seed rounds-1 clean commits, then attempt the crashing one ---\n    // Every round writes v{g}; after rollback the visible value is v{g-1},\n    // after a surviving commit it is v{g}.\n    let mut sim = SimVfs::fresh(policy);\n    for g in 1..=rounds {\n        let (mut repo, _) = Repository::open(sim).expect(\"open before commit\");\n        let res = repo.put(b\"k\".to_vec(), format!(\"v{g}\").into_bytes());\n        sim = repo.into_vfs();\n        match res {\n            Ok(_) => {}\n            Err(StoreError::Io(IoError::SimulatedCrash)) if g == rounds => {}\n            Err(e) => panic!(\"unexpected error on round {g}: {e}\"),\n        }\n    }","new_string":"pub fn run_single(policy: CrashPolicy, rounds: u64) -> CaseResult {\n    let point = policy.at.unwrap_or(CrashPoint::RootSyncEnd);\n    let torn = policy.torn;\n    // Only a crash that lands at/after the final root barrier is a\n    // committed write that survives the reboot.\n    let committed = policy.at == Some(CrashPoint::RootSyncEnd);\n    let expected = if committed { rounds } else { rounds - 1 };\n\n    // Seed rounds-1 clean commits with crash policy disarmed, then arm it\n    // exactly for the target round so earlier commits can never trigger it.\n    let mut sim = SimVfs::fresh(CrashPolicy::never());\n    for g in 1..=rounds {\n        if g == rounds && policy.at.is_some() {\n            sim.set_policy(policy);\n        }\n        let (mut repo, _) = Repository::open(sim).expect(\"open before commit\");\n        let res = repo.put(b\"k\".to_vec(), format!(\"v{g}\").into_bytes());\n        sim = repo.into_vfs();\n        match res {\n            Ok(_) => {}\n            Err(StoreError::Io(IoError::SimulatedCrash)) if g == rounds => {}\n            Err(e) => panic!(\"unexpected error on round {g}: {e}\"),\n        }\n    }"},"name":"Edit","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_83e0c922ab2b25f215f061eb","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1269,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":105272,"output_tokens":743,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_sry86x7iu1kwegeq7o49o1eb":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/b/src/demo.rs","new_string":"pub fn run_single(policy: CrashPolicy, rounds: u64) -> CaseResult {\n    let point = policy.at.unwrap_or(CrashPoint::RootSyncEnd);\n    let torn = policy.torn;\n    // Only a crash that lands at/after the final root barrier is a\n    // committed write that survives the reboot.\n    let committed = policy.at == Some(CrashPoint::RootSyncEnd);\n    let expected = if committed { rounds } else { rounds - {"parentUuid":"69732a58-c80c-46b8-afb0-b59741afbfd3","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_ys84wp3krv3mzxew7sd0dmz8","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp1/b/README.md","content":"# 双页超级块恢复（dual-sb-recovery）\n\n纯 Rust、**零第三方依赖**的追加式键值存储：数据文件追加记录，根节点写入\n**两个交替的超级块**之一，带代次（generation）、根偏移和 CRC-32 校验。\n通过一个**可注入的 I/O 层**在每次写入/同步前后模拟断电（含半页撕裂写），\n验证「先同步数据、再发布根」的崩溃安全提交协议。另附一个仅用标准库实现的\n本地 HTTP 验证入口。无前端。\n\n---\n\n## 1. 它解决什么问题\n\n单个根节点（元数据页）在写入过程中断电会产生撕裂页，可能让存储看到一个\n「半新半旧」的根。本项目用两块固定的超级块页交替发布：\n\n- 提交 N 时，先把新数据记录落盘并 `fsync`，**之后**才把指向它的新超级块\n  写到与上一个根不同的槽位并 `fsync`；\n- 任何时刻至少有一个槽位保存着上一个完整、已校验的根；\n- 恢复时校验两个槽位，**在「完整且其引用链有效」的候选中选取代次最高者**，\n  损坏页（CRC 错、魔数错、指针越界、引用链断裂）一律跳过；\n- 两个槽位都无效时，明确拒绝打开（`NoValidSuperblock`），绝不接受坏根；\n- 数据文件尾部未被任何有效根引用的「孤儿/撕裂」字节在打开时被截掉。\n\n---\n\n## 2. 磁盘格式\n\n仓库就是一个目录，含三个文件（小端字节序，校验均为 CRC-32/ISO-HDLC）：\n\n| 文件 | 作用 |\n|------|------|\n| `data.log` | 追加式记录日志，记录从偏移 0 紧凑排列 |\n| `sb.a` | 超级块槽位 A，存在时恰为 4096 字节 |\n| `sb.b` | 超级块槽位 B，存在时恰为 4096 字节 |\n\n### 2.1 超级块（固定 4096 字节 = 一页）\n\n```\n偏移   长度  字段\n0      4    魔数 b\"DSB1\"\n4      4    格式版本（u32，当前为 1）\n8      8    代次 generation（u64，从 1 起，每次提交 +1）\n16     8    data_len：data.log 的逻辑高水位（u64）\n24     8    root_off：当前链头记录在 data.log 中的绝对偏移（u64）\n32     4    槽位：0=sb.a，1=sb.b\n36     4036 保留，必须为 0\n4072   4    对字节 [0,4072) 的 CRC-32\n4076   20   尾部保留，必须为 0\n```\n\n半页写会破坏 CRC（或使保留区非零），整页被拒绝。\n\n### 2.2 数据记录\n\n```\n偏移  长度  字段\n0     4    魔数 b\"RECD\"\n4     4    载荷长度 L（u32）\n8     4    prev_off：上一条记录的绝对偏移；链首为 NIL=0xFFFFFFFF\n12    8    写入该记录的提交代次（u64）\n20    8    record_off：本条记录自身的绝对偏移（u64，用于位置自检）\n28    8    保留，必须为 0\n36    4    对字节 [0,36) 的 CRC-32\n40    L    载荷\n```\n\n记录总长 `40 + L`。链头记录的代次必须等于超级块代次；更旧的记录保留各自\n写入时的代次。记录紧凑排列，因此第 i 条记录结束偏移恰为第 i+1 条的偏移。\n\n### 2.3 载荷（一次提交可含多个操作）\n\n```\n0  1  操作：1=put，2=delete\n1  4  key 长度 K（u32）\n5  4  value 长度 V（u32，delete 为 0）\n9  K  key（UTF-8 字节）\n9+K V  value（仅 put）\n```\n\n> 偏移字段 `prev_off` 为 u32：单数据文件的逻辑上限约 4 GiB（本工具为本地\n> 验证用途，足够；格式中已用 NIL 哨兵避免「偏移 0」与「无前驱」歧义）。\n\n---\n\n## 3. 同步边界（提交协议）\n\n一次提交恰好追加一条记录、发布一个新根，顺序严格如下：\n\n```\n1. pwrite(data.log, 尾部, 记录)     // 新数据先进入页缓存\n2. fsync(data.log)                  // 屏障：记录已持久\n3. pwrite(另一槽位, 0, 超级块页)     // 根只引用已持久的记录\n   fsync(目录)                      // 仅首次提交：固化新建目录项\n4. fsync(该槽位)                    // 根持久 —— 提交在此点变为可见\n```\n\n关键是 **2 在 3 之前**：根绝不会引用尚未落盘的数据。\n\n| 崩溃位置 | 后果 | 恢复结果 |\n|----------|------|----------|\n| 步骤 1–2（数据写/同步前后） | 旧根完好；新数据缺失或只是尾部撕裂前缀 | 回到上一代，撕裂尾部被截断 |\n| 步骤 3–4（新根写/同步前后） | 数据已在；新根页撕裂，CRC 失败 | 另一槽位的上一代根胜出 |\n| 步骤 4 返回后 | 新根已完整持久 | 新一代可见（崩溃错误仍返回，但数据已落盘） |\n\n---\n\n## 4. 恢复选取算法\n\n1. 读取 `data.log` 长度 `file_len`；读取两个 4096 字节超级块。\n2. 对每页做：长度/魔数/版本校验 → CRC → 保留区清零 → 槽位合法 →\n   代次非零 → `data_len <= file_len` 且 `root_off < data_len`（**越界拒绝**）。\n3. 对通过的页，沿 `root_off → prev_off → …` 走引用链并完整校验：\n   - 每条记录头 CRC、魔数、`record_off` 自检；\n   - 头记录代次 == 超级块代次；\n   - 链必须回走到偏移 0、记录从 0 起紧凑排列、链尾恰在 `data_len`；\n   - 每条载荷可解码。\n4. 在所有「页有效 **且** 引用链有效」的候选中，取**代次最高者**\n   （同代次取槽位号更大者）。\n5. 选中链之后，`file_len` 超出 `data_len` 的部分是孤儿/撕裂尾部，\n   `truncate + fsync` 截掉；随后重放操作重建内存 KV。\n6. 若存在非空超级块但没有任何候选，返回 `NoValidSuperblock`，拒绝打开。\n\n---\n\n## 5. 可注入 I/O 层与故障模型\n\n存储库只依赖 `src/io.rs` 中的 `Vfs` trait（`pwrite / sync / sync_dir /\nread / truncate`）。两个实现：\n\n- **`RealVfs`**：真实目录，`pwrite` + `fsync`，HTTP/CLI 使用。\n- **`SimVfs`**：内存介质，模拟带页缓存的操作系统：\n  - `pwrite` 只进入脏层；`sync` 才把脏段并入「持久介质」；\n  - `CrashPolicy` 可在 8 个 `CrashPoint` 之一**一次性**断电：\n    数据写开始/结束、数据同步开始/结束、根写开始/结束、根同步开始/结束；\n  - `Torn` 控制崩溃时在途写入的存活形态：`None`（全丢）、\n    `Half`（恰好前半页）、`Short`（短前缀）；\n  - 双页超级块恢复（dual-sb-recovery）\n\n纯 Rust、**零第三方依赖**的追加式键值存储：数据文件追加记录，根节点写入\n**两个交替的超级块**之一，带代次（generation）、根偏移和 CRC-32 校验。\n通过一个**可注入的 I/O 层**在每次写入/同步前后模拟断电（含半页撕裂写），\n验证「先同步数据、再发布根」的崩溃安全提交协议。另附一个仅用标准库实现的\n本地 HTTP 验证入口。无前端。\n\n---\n\n## 1. 它解决什么问题\n\n单个根节点（元数据页）在写入过程中断电会产生撕裂页，可能让存储看到一个\n「半新半旧」的根。本项目用两块固定的超级块页交替发布：\n\n- 提交 N 时，先把新数据记录落盘并 `fsync`，**之后**才把指向它的新超级块\n  写到与上一个根不同的槽位并 `fsync`；\n- 任何时刻至少有一个槽位保存着上一个完整、已校验的根；\n- 恢复时校验两个槽位，**在「完整且其引用链有效」的候选中选取代次最高者**，\n  损坏页（CRC 错、魔数错、指针越界、引用链断裂）一律跳过；\n- 两个槽位都无效时，明确拒绝打开（`NoValidSuperblock`），绝不接受坏根；\n- 数据文件尾部未被任何有效根引用的「孤儿/撕裂」字节在打开时被截掉。\n\n---\n\n## 2. 磁盘格式\n\n仓库就是一个目录，含三个文件（小端字节序，校验均为 CRC-32/ISO-HDLC）：\n\n| 文件 | 作用 |\n|------|------|\n| `data.log` | 追加式记录日志，记录从偏移 0 紧凑排列 |\n| `sb.a` | 超级块槽位 A，存在时恰为 4096 字节 |\n| `sb.b` | 超级块槽位 B，存在时恰为 4096 字节 |\n\n### 2.1 超级块（固定 4096 字节 = 一页）\n\n```\n偏移   长度  字段\n0      4    魔数 b\"DSB1\"\n4      4    格式版本（u32，当前为 1）\n8      8    代次 generation（u64，从 1 起，每次提交 +1）\n16     8    data_len：data.log 的逻辑高水位（u64）\n24     8    root_off：当前链头记录在 data.log 中的绝对偏移（u64）\n32     4    槽位：0=sb.a，1=sb.b\n36     4036 保留，必须为 0\n4072   4    对字节 [0,4072) 的 CRC-32\n4076   20   尾部保留，必须为 0\n```\n\n半页写会破坏 CRC（或使保留区非零），整页被拒绝。\n\n### 2.2 数据记录\n\n```\n偏移  长度  字段\n0     4    魔数 b\"RECD\"\n4     4    载荷长度 L（u32）\n8     4    prev_off：上一条记录的绝对偏移；链首为 NIL=0xFFFFFFFF\n12    8    写入该记录的提交代次（u64）\n20    8    record_off：本条记录自身的绝对偏移（u64，用于位置自检）\n28    8    保留，必须为 0\n36    4    对字节 [0,36) 的 CRC-32\n40    L    载荷\n```\n\n记录总长 `40 + L`。链头记录的代次必须等于超级块代次；更旧的记录保留各自\n写入时的代次。记录紧凑排列，因此第 i 条记录结束偏移恰为第 i+1 条的偏移。\n\n### 2.3 载荷（一次提交可含多个操作）\n\n```\n0  1  操作：1=put，2=delete\n1  4  key 长度 K（u32）\n5  4  value 长度 V（u32，delete 为 0）\n9  K  key（UTF-8 字节）\n9+K V  value（仅 put）\n```\n\n> 偏移字段 `prev_off` 为 u32：单数据文件的逻辑上限约 4 GiB（本工具为本地\n> 验证用途，足够；格式中已用 NIL 哨兵避免「偏移 0」与「无前驱」歧义）。\n\n---\n\n## 3. 同步边界（提交协议）\n\n一次提交恰好追加一条记录、发布一个新根，顺序严格如下：\n\n```\n1. pwrite(data.log, 尾部, 记录)     // 新数据先进入页缓存\n2. fsync(data.log)                  // 屏障：记录已持久\n3. pwrite(另一槽位, 0, 超级块页)     // 根只引用已持久的记录\n   fsync(目录)                      // 仅首次提交：固化新建目录项\n4. fsync(该槽位)                    // 根持久 —— 提交在此点变为可见\n```\n\n关键是 **2 在 3 之前**：根绝不会引用尚未落盘的数据。\n\n| 崩溃位置 | 后果 | 恢复结果 |\n|----------|------|----------|\n| 步骤 1–2（数据写/同步前后） | 旧根完好；新数据缺失或只是尾部撕裂前缀 | 回到上一代，撕裂尾部被截断 |\n| 步骤 3–4（新根写/同步前后） | 数据已在；新根页撕裂，CRC 失败 | 另一槽位的上一代根胜出 |\n| 步骤 4 返回后 | 新根已完整持久 | 新一代可见（崩溃错误仍返回，但数据已落盘） |\n\n---\n\n## 4. 恢复选取算法\n\n1. 读取 `data.log` 长度 `file_len`；读取两个 4096 字节超级块。\n2. 对每页做：长度/魔数/版本校验 → CRC → 保留区清零 → 槽位合法 →\n   代次非零 → `data_len <= file_len` 且 `root_off < data_len`（**越界拒绝**）。\n3. 对通过的页，沿 `root_off → prev_off → …` 走引用链并完整校验：\n   - 每条记录头 CRC、魔数、`record_off` 自检；\n   - 头记录代次 == 超级块代次；\n   - 链必须回走到偏移 0、记录从 0 起紧凑排列、链尾恰在 `data_len`；\n   - 每条载荷可解码。\n4. 在所有「页有效 **且** 引用链有效」的候选中，取**代次最高者**\n   （同代次取槽位号更大者）。\n5. 选中链之后，`file_len` 超出 `data_len` 的部分是孤儿/撕裂尾部，\n   `truncate + fsync` 截掉；随后重放操作重建内存 KV。\n6. 若存在非空超级块但没有任何候选，返回 `NoValidSuperblock`，拒绝打开。\n\n---\n\n## 5. 可注入 I/O 层与故障模型\n\n存储库只依赖 `src/io.rs` 中的 `Vfs` trait（`pwrite / sync / sync_dir /\nread / truncate`）。两个实现：\n\n- **`RealVfs`**：真实目录，`pwrite` + `fsync`，HTTP/CLI 使用。\n- **`SimVfs`**：内存介质，模拟带页缓存的操作系统：\n  - `pwrite` 只进入脏层；`sync` 才把脏段并入「持久介质」；\n  - `CrashPolicy` 可在 8 个 `CrashPoint` 之一**一次性**断电：\n    数据写开始/结束、数据同步开始/结束、根写开始/结束、根同步开始/结束；\n  - `Torn` 控制崩溃时在途写入的存活形态：`None`（全丢）、\n    `Half`（恰好前半页）、`Short`（短前缀）；\n  - 断电会清空全部脏层（等价于掉电后冷页缓存）；对**同一份持久介质**\n    调用 `reopen` 即「重启」，恢复代码看到的就是掉电后真实存活的字节。\n\n> 故障策略只在目标提交**打开仓库之后**武装，因此恢复过程自身可能做的\n> 截断/同步不会误触发注入的崩溃。\n\n---\n\n## 6. 构建与运行\n\n需要 Rust（在 `rustc 1.98.1`
